reason: Reviewed lifecycle hooks, the Notifai skill, harness setup, CLI readiness, and domain terms after binding first-party skill installation to the exact guidance shipped in the npm package. Init now verifies and stages that package-bound copy for the pinned native installer, removes the staging copy, and readiness re-hashes the conventional installed directory without trusting mutable lock metadata. Windows now invokes npm's real npx JavaScript entry point from the running Node distribution, avoiding cwd-sensitive or environment-selected command shims and failing closed if npm is absent. The shipped skill's behavior clauses and setup commands remain unchanged; the stronger integrity and portability checks enforce the existing immutable-guidance promise without requiring new Agent Guidance wording.
